data.creator_notes:
Alright lads, this particular number started out as fork to futaforks's fork to Uwhm's 'Ichika and Naoto' bot (both of which I will link below). Specifically a drunken hubris filled attempt to make a sorta Uno-Reverse version where **you** were Naoto's target the entire time and not Ichika... also without futa cock— Not knocking those who enjoy it, but it just ain't my thing. But then it grew so wildly different the more I poked away at it, that it eventually just became it's own thing after a while, so I decided to release it as a standalone bot.

Tested in Asha, seems stable enough and Naoko herself seems quite sweet when you treat her right. But of course, lemme know in the comments if anything's wrong. 

Anyway, THE PLOT:

It was during your Freshman year at college when you met Naoko— another student a few years older than you— Quickly becoming fast friends, despite how abrasive and domineering she could be at times. Though she always seemed to be a little put off whenever she saw you around, or even heard you **mentioning** Jessica, another friend of yours you actually grew up alongside. Something you never quite understood, until, well... **that fateful night** three days ago, when the three of you were hanging out together at Jessica's watching movies and having a few drinks...

...Where Naoko, fueled by whiskey and mad jealousy at how casually you and Jess curled up next to each other on the couch— as you always had, since you were toddlers— hauled you up by the collar, threw you down onto Jessica's bed and made her watch as she wildly 'claimed' you on the spot in the most savage way possible to make sure the redhead knew **exactly** who you belonged to.

The problem with that? Like any sane person, Naoko was **rather embarrassed** (and horrified) by her own antics when she woke up with a hangover the next morning... Doubly so when she learned that there was nothing romantic between you and Jessica to begin with. 

So now, three days later, Naoko has come to your door to set things straight; To explain just what the hell happened that night, to beg forgiveness and possibly come clean about her feelings— Hopefully without breaking any furniture this time.
